# Verbix

> > Verbix is a comprehensive verb conjugation and noun declension reference covering hundreds of languages from Proto-Indo-European to modern Romance, Germanic, Semitic, and regional languages worldwide.

Verbix provides detailed grammatical tools for linguists, language learners, and researchers, featuring conjugation patterns for both living and historical languages including Proto-Germanic, Latin, Romance languages, and lesser-studied regional dialects. The platform specializes in morphological analysis across diverse language families with particular depth in Indo-European languages.

## Key Topics

- verb conjugation
- noun declension
- Romance languages
- Germanic languages
- Proto-Indo-European
- historical linguistics

## Major Modern Languages

- [Galician - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/galician): Galician Romance language verb conjugation from Northwestern Spain
- [Maltese - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/maltese): Maltese Semitic language verb conjugation with triliteral patterns
- [Vietnamese - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/vietnamese): Vietnamese Austroasiatic isolating language verb conjugation guide
- [Declension of Greek Nouns](https://www.verbix.com/languages/greek-nouns): Greek noun declension guide covering Ancient and Modern Greek cases
- [Declension of Norwegian Nynorsk Nouns](https://www.verbix.com/languages/norwegian-nynorsk-nouns): Norwegian Nynorsk noun declension with gender and inflection guide
- [Declension of Romanian Adjectives](https://www.verbix.com/languages/romanian-adjectives): Romanian adjective declension for Latin-derived Romance language
- [Declension of Zulu Nouns](https://www.verbix.com/languages/zulu-nouns): Zulu noun declension reference with classes from South Africa

## Historical and Proto-Languages

- [Proto-Germanic - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/proto-germanic): Proto-Germanic strong/weak verb conjugation with ablaut patterns
- [Proto-Italic - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/proto-italic): Proto-Italic verb conjugation for ancestral Romance languages
- [Classical Armenian - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/armenian-classical): Classical Armenian historical verb conjugation tool
- [Old East Slavic - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/old-east-slavic): Old East Slavic historical verb conjugator for Novgorod/Kiev era
- [Old Dutch - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/old-dutch): Old Dutch Franconian verb conjugation from Early Middle Ages
- [Declension of Gothic Nouns](https://www.verbix.com/languages/gothic-nouns): Gothic noun declension for extinct Germanic language of Wulfila
- [Pali - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/pali): Pali Middle Indo-Aryan liturgical language verb conjugation tool

## Regional and Minority Languages

- [Wu - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/wu): Wu Chinese dialect verb conjugator for Shanghai/Zhejiang region
- [Piemontese - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/piemontese): Piemontese Romance language verb conjugator from Piedmont, Italy
- [West Makian - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/west-makian): West Makian verb conjugation tool for North Maluku Province language
- [Saint Lucian Creole French - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/st_lucien): Saint Lucian Creole French verb conjugator for Caribbean language
- [Caló - verb conjugation](https://www.verbix.com/languages/calo): Caló Romani-Spanish mixed language verb conjugation reference
